name: Pathfinder 1st Edition
description: A character sheet for the first edition of the Pathfinder Roleplaying Game, after the 2009 character sheet: abilities with temporary adjustments, AC with touch and flat-footed, saves, initiative, base attack, CMB and CMD with size, every skill with class-skill, armor check penalty and size applied, carrying capacity and loads, and spell save DCs and bonus spells.
author: hunter-read

ac.formula: 10 + armor_bonus + shield_bonus + dex_eff + size_mod + natural_armor + deflection + ac_misc
ac.label: Armor Class

bab_iterative.formula: bab >= 16 ? concat(signed(bab), '/', signed(bab - 5), '/', signed(bab - 10), '/', signed(bab - 15)) : (bab >= 11 ? concat(signed(bab), '/', signed(bab - 5), '/', signed(bab - 10)) : (bab >= 6 ? concat(signed(bab), '/', signed(bab - 5)) : signed(bab)))
bab_iterative.label: Attacks

sk_acrobatics.formula: signed(dex_eff + sk_acrobatics_ranks + sk_acrobatics_misc + (contains(class_skills, 'Acrobatics') and sk_acrobatics_ranks > 0 ? 3 : 0) + acp)
sk_acrobatics.label: Acrobatics

sk_climb.formula: signed(str_eff + sk_climb_ranks + sk_climb_misc + (contains(class_skills, 'Climb') and sk_climb_ranks > 0 ? 3 : 0) + acp)

sk_disable_device.formula: sk_disable_device_ranks == 0 ? '—' : signed(dex_eff + sk_disable_device_ranks + sk_disable_device_misc + (contains(class_skills, 'Disable Device') and sk_disable_device_ranks > 0 ? 3 : 0) + acp)
